summary: Your cover letter introduces your Civil Engineering background and AutoCAD experience, but it is very brief. To stand out, you need to expand on your project details and highlight specific engineering skills.
strengths: Clearly states your degree in Civil Engineering from Demo Institute.
Mentions practical experience using AutoCAD on a bridge design project.

gaps.why: The bridge design project is your main selling point, but you do not mention the type of bridge, the design constraints, or the specific engineering principles you applied.
You mention wanting to use your 'skills' and being a 'team player' without specifying what those technical skills are or providing an example of your teamwork in action.
The letter lacks any mention of the outcome of your project, such as whether it was presented to faculty, received a high grade, or met specific design criteria.
